name: Camping am Badsee
beschreibung: The campsite Camping am Badsee is located in Isny im Allgäu in Tirol. It offers pitches for tents, motorhomes and caravans. The Badsee is directly nearby and suitable for swimming. The site has sanitary facilities and electrical hookups. The region is suitable for hiking, cycling and water sports. The campsite is a base camp for exploring the surrounding area.
